mapper.select: select state_key, CAST(state_data AS text) as state_data, update_time from app_business_state where state_key = #{stateKey} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into app_business_state ( state_key, state_data, update_time ) values ( #{stateKey}, CAST(#{stateData} AS jsonb), now() ) on conflict (state_key) do update set state_data = excluded.state_data, update_time = now()
